provenance.frame: Geometric ecliptic J2000 / ICRF; AU and AU/day; input instants UT.
provenance.sampling: 28 quarterly planet dates and 210 tithi transitions (30 consecutive transitions starting January 1 of each year), 2024–2030. Not an exhaustive bound over the continuous range.
provenance.transitions: Engine-predicted transition instants are query inputs, not expected answers. JPL independently supplies Sun/Moon position and velocity at those instants; tests convert phase residual to timing error.
